mapper.select: select a.*, b.SN as vehicleApplySn,b.USERS as vehicleApplyUsers,b.VEHICLE as vehicleApplyVehicle,b.DRIVER as vehicleApplyDriver from BIZ_CAR_SERVICE_RATINGS a left join BIZ_CAR_VEHICLE_APPLY b on a.VEHICLE_APPLY_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}

select b.*, a.SN as vehicleApplySn,a.USERS as vehicleApplyUsers,a.VEHICLE as vehicleApplyVehicle,a.DRIVER as vehicleApplyDriver from BIZ_CAR_VEHICLE_APPLY a left join BIZ_CAR_SERVICE_RATINGS b on a.ID = b.VEHICLE_APPLY_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' where a.ID = #{applyId}

select b.*, a.SN as vehicleApplySn,a.USERS as vehicleApplyUsers,a.VEHICLE as vehicleApplyVehicle,a.DRIVER as vehicleApplyDriver from BIZ_CAR_VEHICLE_APPLY a join BIZ_CAR_SERVICE_RATINGS b on a.ID = b.VEHICLE_APPLY_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' where a.DRIVER_USER_ID = #{driverId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' order by b.CREATE_TIME desc
